dispositions.topic_text: Closed set of required categories and treatment of missing, duplicate, or unknown categories
Indexed fact and classification rules determining membership in States 0–2
Required test coverage for exact category outcomes and rejection of UNRESOLVED
Required total number of review records and criteria for a complete record
Definition, vocabulary, and exact cardinality of a category outcome
Authority and individual-versus-collective criteria for judging whether referenced decisions answer a category
Requirement, grammar, resolution, and freshness rules for affected evidence
Failure-reporting precedence and multiplicity when several gate conditions fail
dispositions.reason: Pass or fail is all A21 decides; which failures design_lint reports and in what order is the Workbench gate's diagnostics, the same for every case, and no product behaviour depends on it

dispositions.topic_text: Supplied index evidence establishing resolution and qualification of the listed security-review references
dispositions.reason: The design index is computed by the Workbench from the case's documents (design_index), not authored text; design_lint --state 2 resolves every reference of this record against it with 0 errors

dispositions.topic_text: Exact version-pinned canonical review-record grammar and how it is supplied to implementations
dispositions.reason: No generated code reads A21: it is checked by design_lint at authoring time, and the grammar is the SECURITY_REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md of the case branch's own tools, versioned with them
